long_description: GodHands learns how your teams actually work, capturing the steps, decisions, and exceptions that never get written down. It turns that knowledge into living playbooks and answers with sources, so people and AI agents can put it to work. Teams use GodHands to run operations, onboard employees, hand over roles, integrate acquisitions, and automate work.
name: GodHands
one_liner: Your company’s operating model, learned from the work.
